{{Quote|He saw the death of his wife, Fheela.|Kam Solusar remembering his wife's death|<ref name="Lightsider" />}}
'''Fheela''' was the wife of [[Kam Solusar]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], as well as the mother of Kam's two sons, [[Jaxor Solusar]] and [[Tev Solusar]]. In order to protect his family from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kam Solusar had Fheela and his children hidden on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Anoth/Legends|Anoth]] under the protection of his father, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ranik Solusar]]. Despite this, Fheela and her children were located by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] to death.

==Behind the scenes==
Set between ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]'' in [[10 ABY]], the cancelled novella ''[[Lightsider (story)|Star Wars: Lightsider]]'' was set to introduce Fheela as Kam Solusar's long-dead wife. However, the unofficially released manuscript of ''Lightsider''<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarstimeline.net/latest_news.htm|text=Lightsider Online Release|work=StarWarsTimeline Expanded Universe News|quote="In case you missed it, here is the PDF for the Tom Veitch story, Lightsider, a lost EU work that takes place between Dark Empire I and II. Click on the title here or on the right column to download Tom Veitch's unpublished, previously lost bridge story between Dark Empires I and II" - Joseph Bongiorno.|archivedate=20231209175121}}</ref> provides a major discrepancy surrounding the time of Fheela and her sons' deaths. Kam Solusar mentions within the manuscript that his family was murdered "thirty-five years ago"<ref name="Lightsider" />, which would would indicate that they died in 25 BBY. However, 25 BBY was six years before Darth Vader began hunting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as part of the Great Jedi Purge.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
